final_netlist:
.subckt dut iin vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: IREF into NMOS diode; IREF/8 branch makes PMOS gate bias
MN0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=16 L=1
MN2 pb    ibias vss vss nfet W=2  L=1
MP0 pb    pb    vdd vdd pfet W=1  L=1
* RC filter on PMOS bias to suppress bias-branch noise
Rb  pb    pbf   2Meg
Cb  pbf   vdd   2p
* gain stage
M1  x     iin   vss vss nfet W=24 L=0.35
MP1 x     pbf   vdd vdd pfet W=16 L=1
* feedback: larger Rf for gain margin, smaller Cf to preserve bandwidth
Rf  x     iin   480k
Cf  x     iin   2f
* PMOS source follower output buffer
M2  vss   x     vout vout pfet W=60 L=0.15
MP3 vout  pbf   vdd  vdd  pfet W=5  L=1
.ends
